summary: Closed three defects T39's recheck found beyond T38/T50's exhaustive-mapping rewrites: (1) security report's exit code now sources its strict-mode decision from the workspace's own config instead of the stored artifact's own mode field; (2) reportExitCode's enforced arm now accepts only pass, matching ci, closing the codebase's one remaining enforced-more-permissive-than-ci inversion per the reviewer's explicit ruling; (3) health service.ts's readLatest now treats a missing or malformed gate shape as unusable evidence (the existing no-report outcome) instead of letting a TypeError escape gate().

acceptance.criterion: AC4 (AC-05) / AC8: no required failed or incomplete check is relabeled PASS at any surface including the process exit code; a strict mode accepts only a pass; an artifact under judgement cannot select the strictness applied to it.
acceptance.evidence: Defect 1: handleReport now calls reportExitCode(report.gate, await modeOf(cwd)) instead of report.mode; verified at the real CLI entry point via T55-verify-real-cli.ts (exitCode 1 for workspace ci + stored mode advisory + gate fail, was 0). Defect 2: reportExitCode(gate, "enforced") now returns 1 for fail/needs-approval/incomplete/unrecognized, 0 only for pass. Defect 3: a health report with no gate key or a malformed gate shape now returns {status:"fail", exitCode:1}, never a thrown exception.

acceptance.criterion: Policy (policies.md): FAIL on an established threshold violation; INCOMPLETE when a required check is missing/skipped/unparsed/unfinished; strict CI accepts only PASS; optional skip warns and is never signed as passed; messages stay constant and leak-safe.
acceptance.evidence: isPassGate and gateExitCode (unchanged, already exhaustive per T38/T50) still enforce FAIL/INCOMPLETE/PASS. Both strict security modes (ci, enforced) now accept only PASS via reportExitCode. The health unusable-evidence reason reuses the pre-existing constant leak-safe string "no report; run `keryx health run` first" — no new interpolation.

acceptance.criterion: Regressions fail before the change and pass after, covering: a stored report whose recorded mode is more permissive than the workspace's, the enforced arm on a failing and on an incomplete gate, and a stored report with no gate key. Everything the previous rewrites closed stays closed; the recognized-value truth tables do not move except where this task deliberately changes them, and each change is stated.
acceptance.evidence: Four new regression tests: mismatched-mode CLI test (both directions), corrected enforced-arm unit test, no-gate-key and gate-as-array health tests. Full owned/read focused-test run: 144 pass/0 fail/460 expect() before -> 148 pass/0 fail/472 expect() after, zero pre-existing test broken except the one corrected assertion (justified in T55-implementation.md). Truth-table deltas stated explicitly: only reportExitCode's four enforced+non-pass cells moved (0->1); every ci/advisory/gateway cell and every gateExitCode/isPassGate cell is unchanged.

artifacts.summary: Pre-coding spec: per-defect decision (mode source from workspace vs validating report.mode), the enforced/ci symmetry fix, and the health shape-guard design, each with the truth-table deltas stated up front.

Per-defect before/after code, truth tables, reviewer's-probe before/after, supplementary real-CLI probe, regression test descriptions, verification counts and raw log paths, acceptance mapping, concerns, changed files, routing audit.
